mapper.insert: INSERT INTO b_task_status ( `api_code`, `batch_number`, `create_time`, `update_time`, `all_status`, `incr_date`, incr_status, once_status, file_id ) VALUES ( #{apiCode}, #{batchNumber}, now(), now(), #{allStatus}, #{incrDate}, #{incrStatus}, #{onceStatus}, #{fileId} )
mapper.select: SELECT api_code,batch_number,once_status,create_time,update_time,incr_date,incr_status FROM b_task_status WHERE batch_number=#{batchNumber} AND once_status=1
SELECT api_code,batch_number,all_status,create_time,update_time,incr_date,incr_status FROM b_task_status WHERE batch_number=#{batchNumber} AND incr_status=1 AND create_time>curdate()
SELECT api_code,batch_number,all_status,create_time,update_time,incr_date,incr_status FROM b_task_status WHERE batch_number=#{batchNumber} AND all_status=1
SELECT api_code,batch_number,all_status,create_time,update_time,incr_date,incr_status FROM b_task_status WHERE batch_number=#{batchNumber} AND all_status=1
SELECT api_code,batch_number,all_status,create_time,update_time,incr_date,incr_status FROM b_task_status WHERE batch_number=#{batchNumber} order by id desc LIMIT 1
